The National Insurance Company Ltd vs Sri Tapan Debnath And
Another on 19 May, 2023

Page 1 of 2
 High Court Of Tripura
 Agartala
 Mac App. No.38 of 2023

The National Insurance Company Ltd.
 ........................ Appellant(s).

Versus
Sri Tapan Debnath and Another
 ........................ Respondent(s).
For Appellant(s) : Mr. A.K. Deb, Advocate.
Hon'Ble The Chief Justice Mr. Aparesh Kumar Singh

The instant appeal is directed against the award dated 30.01.2023 passed in T.S.(MAC) No.292 of 2015 by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Tribunal No.4), West Tripura, Agartala whereby and whereunder the OP No.2/appellant herein being insurer of the offending vehicle has been ordered to pay the compensation of Rs 30,33,941/- (Rupees thirty lakhs thirty three thousand nine hundred and forty one) within a period of 30(thirty) days from the date of the award with a stipulation that the same shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of presentation of the claim petition on 22nd December, 2015 till realization.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The instant appeal is directed against the award dated 30.01.2023 passed in T.S.(MAC) No.292 of 2015 by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Tribunal No.4), West Tripura, Agartala whereby and whereunder the OP No.2/appellant herein being insurer of the offending vehicle has been ordered to pay the compensation of Rs 30,33,941/- (Rupees thirty lakhs thirty three thousand nine hundred and forty one) within a period of 30(thirty) days from the date of the award with a stipulation that the same shall carry interest @ 9% per annum from the date of presentation of the claim petition on 22nd December, 2015 till realization.
The claim has been allowed under Section 166 of the M.V. Act, 1988.
Issue notice upon the respondent No.1-claimant and respondent No.2-owner under ordinary process and registered cover with A/D, for which requisites be filed within 1(one) week, failing which this appeal shall be dismissed without further reference to this Court.
Notice is made returnable on 27.06.2023.
